name: Tackling Structural Exclusion
rule: Why these groups World Bank 2013, Inclusion Matters. Groups are excluded from markets, services and spaces; dignity runs across all three.

name: Markets
def: Barriers that keep group members out of, or unprotected in, labour and other markets, including the worker side of the formality split.

name: Exclusion from markets: labour, informality and workers' rights
def: Barriers that keep group members out of, or unprotected in, labour and other markets: discrimination, care burdens, informality of work, labour contracts and rights. Holds the worker side of the formality split.
ex: Examples from plans Protect worker rights and labour standards · Reform labour market regulation · Expand care services

name: Taste-based and statistical discrimination
chain: Works when enforcement of non-discrimination · How group identity in hiring, lending and services → prejudice or group averages lower access · Result gaps in employment, pay and services

name: Unpaid care burden and female labour supply
chain: Works when affordable care services · How care responsibilities → time in unpaid care limits paid work · Result female employment and earnings

name: Employment protection and hiring
chain: Works when enforcement · How dismissal rules and labour regulation → stricter rules lower hiring and formal employment · Result formal employment and output

name: Informality and formalisation costs
chain: Works when enforcement and benefits · How costs and benefits of formal work → high costs keep workers and firms informal · Result formal employment and coverage

name: Worker voice and labour standards
chain: Works when freedom of association · How collective representation and standards → voice improves conditions and reduces turnover · Result working conditions and wages

name: Workplace safety enforcement
chain: Works when credible inspections · How inspections and safety rules → enforcement lowers injury without job loss · Result injury rates

name: Extension of contributory social insurance to informal workers
cite: Levy 2008; ILO World Social Protection Report 2020-22 (source still to check)
chain: Works when contribution design and enforcement · How informality of work → contribution and eligibility rules exclude informal workers · Result coverage gaps in pensions and health insurance
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Services
def: Administrative, physical and informational barriers to services and entitlements.

name: Exclusion from services and entitlements
def: Administrative, physical and informational barriers that keep group members from services and entitlements they are eligible for.
ex: Examples from plans Promote social inclusion · Strengthen disability inclusion · Expand legal identity and civil registration

name: Disability-related access barriers
chain: Works when accessible design · How physical, information and attitudinal barriers → barriers limit schooling, work and services · Result poverty and exclusion of disabled people

name: Documentation barriers to entitlements
chain: Works when registration reach · How lack of legal identity → no document, no access to services, finance and voting · Result exclusion from services and rights
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Spaces
def: Voice and standing in social and political spaces, protection from violence, and the place of displaced people.
basis: Inclusion Matters: political, social, physical and cultural spaces; dignity

name: Exclusion from social and political spaces
def: Norms, under-representation and between-group inequality that restrict voice and standing of excluded groups.
ex: Examples from plans Advance gender equality · Preserve language and traditional knowledge

name: Gender norms and intra-household bargaining
chain: Works when outside options · How women's control of resources → norms and bargaining power decide allocation within households · Result women's and children's outcomes

name: Political representation of excluded groups
chain: Works when real authority · How reserved or increased representation → representatives allocate to their group's priorities · Result public goods matching excluded groups' needs

name: Horizontal inequalities and group grievance
chain: Works when political exclusion of the group · How inequality between identity groups → group-level grievance mobilises · Result risk of conflict

name: Intergroup contact and prejudice reduction
chain: Works when equal status; common goals · How structured contact across groups → cooperation reduces prejudice · Result tolerance and cooperation
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Violence, coercion and denial of dignity
def: Violence and exploitation inside households and labour markets that strip rights and dignity from the most exposed groups.
ex: Examples from plans Strengthen child protection · Prevent gender-based violence · Strengthen social services

name: Intimate-partner violence and women's bargaining power
chain: Works when services and justice response · How women's outside options and norms → stronger options lower violence; backlash is possible · Result prevalence of intimate-partner violence

name: Household poverty and child labour
chain: Works when income support and schooling · How household income near subsistence → children work when adult income is too low · Result child labour and lost schooling

name: Child marriage and girls' human capital
chain: Works when enforcement and incentives · How age at marriage → early marriage cuts schooling and work · Result girls' education and earnings

name: Early adversity and lifetime outcomes
chain: Works when protective services · How abuse and neglect in childhood → trauma impairs development · Result adult earnings and health
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Displaced and uprooted populations
def: Displacement by conflict, disaster, climate or projects, and integration of displaced people in host communities.
ex: Examples from plans Compensate and resettle affected communities · Support refugees, migrants and returnees

name: Impoverishment risks of displacement
chain: Works when restoration of livelihoods · How forced displacement or resettlement → loss of land, jobs, housing and networks · Result impoverishment of the displaced

name: Migration as adaptation
chain: Works when barriers trap the poorest · How environmental pressure on livelihoods → mobility lets households diversify risk · Result resilience, if mobility is supported

name: Refugee integration and host labour markets
chain: Works when right to work · How refugees' access to work and services → integration turns refugees into workers and consumers · Result outcomes for refugees and hosts
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Enhancing Capabilities
rule: Why these groups UNDP Human Development Index dimensions; HDR 1994 human security. A long and healthy life, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.

name: Decent standard of living
def: Income security, food security and personal safety.
basis: HDI: decent standard of living; HDR 1994: economic, food and personal security

name: Economic security
def: Transfers, insurance and asset building that hold household consumption steady and lift households past poverty thresholds.
ex: Examples from plans Expand social protection coverage · Expand social assistance · Improve social protection delivery and targeting

name: Consumption smoothing through transfers and insurance
chain: Works when speed and adequacy · How transfers or insurance when income falls → income support holds consumption · Result stable consumption

name: Prevention of adverse coping
chain: Works when timing before coping · How support during shocks → stops distress asset sales and school withdrawal · Result avoided persistent losses

name: Ex ante risk-taking under protection
chain: Works when credible payout · How credible insurance → lower risk lets households invest in riskier, higher-return activities · Result investment and income

name: Shock-responsive scale-up
chain: Works when registry coverage · How systems that expand automatically in a shock → pre-built registries and triggers add caseload fast · Result timely support after shocks

name: Old-age income security
cite: Holzmann and Hinz 2005; Barr and Diamond 2008
chain: Works when coverage and adequacy · How pensions → income in old age without earnings · Result old-age poverty and consumption

name: Financial protection from catastrophic health costs
cite: Xu et al. 2003; Wagstaff et al. 2018
chain: Works when benefit package and enrolment · How health insurance and fee exemptions → pooling stops medical bills from impoverishing · Result catastrophic spending and impoverishment

name: Targeting accuracy and coverage of the poor
cite: Coady, Grosh and Hoddinott 2004; Alatas et al. 2012
chain: Works when data quality and community input · How eligibility rules and registries → better targeting reduces exclusion and inclusion errors · Result share of transfers reaching the poor

name: Cash transfers and productive investment
cite: Haushofer and Shapiro 2016; Egger et al. 2022
chain: Works when local supply response · How unconditional cash → relieves liquidity constraints; spending creates local multipliers · Result assets, consumption and local output

name: Big-push asset transfers
cite: Banerjee et al. 2015 (Science); Bandiera et al. 2017
chain: Works when complementary support · How asset plus training and support → a big push moves households past an asset threshold · Result sustained income gains

name: Conditional transfers and human-capital investment
chain: Works when supply of services · How transfers conditioned on schooling or health → conditions shift spending to children's human capital · Result schooling and health of children
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Food security
def: Household command over adequate, safe food and the nutrition that follows.
ex: Examples from plans Improve food security · Improve nutrition · Strengthen food safety and quality

name: Entitlement failure and food access
chain: Works when functioning markets · How income and prices facing households → famines and hunger follow loss of command over food, not only supply · Result food access

name: Early-life nutrition and lifetime productivity
cite: Hoddinott et al. 2008; Victora et al. 2008
chain: Works when timing · How nutrition in the first 1000 days → early nutrition shapes growth and cognition · Result adult earnings

name: Food price shocks and net-buyer welfare
chain: Works when household position · How food price changes → net buyers lose and net sellers gain · Result poverty

name: Foodborne disease and food safety
cite: Havelaar et al. 2015; Jaffee et al. 2019
chain: Works when enforcement along chains · How food safety controls → contaminated food causes illness and trade rejections · Result disease burden and market access

name: Food loss along supply chains
chain: Works when storage incentives · How post-harvest handling and storage → losses cut supply and income · Result food available and farm income

name: School feeding and attendance
chain: Works when local procurement · How meals at school → food at school raises attendance and nutrition · Result attendance and nutrition
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Personal security
def: Crime and violence in public life and the deterrence, justice and rehabilitation channels that reduce them.
ex: Examples from plans Reform the justice sector · Strengthen law enforcement and policing · Expand access to justice

name: Deterrence and the economics of crime
chain: Works when certainty matters more than severity · How probability and severity of sanction → higher expected cost deters offending · Result crime rates

name: Behavioural and social prevention of violence
cite: Blattman, Jamison and Sheridan 2017; Heller et al. 2017
chain: Works when follow-up · How programmes changing decisions and opportunities of at-risk people → therapy and support reduce impulsive violence · Result violence and crime

name: Legal empowerment and dispute resolution
cite: Blattman, Hartman and Blair 2014; Sandefur and Siddiqi 2013
chain: Works when legitimacy of fora · How access to legal aid and fair dispute resolution → disputes resolved peacefully protect property and safety · Result violence and security of property

name: Incarceration, rehabilitation and recidivism
chain: Works when programme quality · How custody and rehabilitation → rehabilitative custody lowers re-offending · Result recidivism and employment

name: Illicit markets and trafficking violence
chain: Works when coordination across places · How enforcement against illicit markets → crackdowns can redirect and increase violence · Result violence and trafficking
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Long and healthy life
def: Health services, prevention, and the living environment that shapes health.
basis: HDI: long and healthy life; HDR 1994: health and environmental security

name: Health security
def: Health service coverage and quality, and prevention of disease and injury.
ex: Examples from plans Improve transport safety · Expand access to health services · Build health workforce

name: Service coverage and avoidable mortality
cite: Starfield, Shi and Macinko 2005; Kruk et al. 2018
chain: Works when quality of care (Kruk et al. 2018) · How coverage of effective services → access to care averts deaths · Result mortality and morbidity

name: Provider quality and effort
chain: Works when incentives and supervision · How provider knowledge and effort → the know-do gap determines care quality · Result health outcomes

name: Health workforce density and coverage
chain: Works when distribution of staff · How health workers per capita → workforce density enables service coverage · Result coverage and mortality

name: Essential medicines access and quality
chain: Works when supply chains; regulation · How availability, price and quality of medicines → access to quality medicines makes treatment effective · Result treatment outcomes

name: Maternal and newborn intervention coverage
chain: Works when quality of facility births · How coverage of proven maternal and newborn interventions → skilled care at birth averts deaths · Result maternal and newborn mortality

name: Behavioural risk factors and prevention
cite: Dupas 2011; Cawley and Ruhm 2011; Lee et al. 2012
chain: Works when information and price signals · How diet, inactivity and health behaviours → behaviour drives chronic disease risk; under-investment in prevention · Result NCD burden

name: Infectious disease externalities
cite: Gersovitz and Hammer 2004; Miguel and Kremer 2004
chain: Works when public subsidy · How control of infectious disease → treatment and prevention protect others, so private demand is too low · Result incidence and transmission

name: Addictive consumption and harm
cite: Becker and Murphy 1988; Chaloupka and Warner 2000
chain: Works when enforcement · How tobacco, alcohol and drugs → addiction makes current use raise future demand; taxes and limits work · Result use and harm

name: Injury prevention
cite: Kopits and Cropper 2005; Habyarimana and Jack 2011
chain: Works when enforcement · How road and transport safety measures → lower risk-taking and safer environments cut crashes · Result injury deaths

name: Mental health and economic functioning
chain: Works when access to treatment · How mental health → depression and anxiety impair decisions and work; poverty worsens them · Result employment and earnings
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Living environment and basic services
def: First access to electricity, water, sanitation, clean cooking and adequate housing.
ex: Examples from plans Expand affordable housing · Expand access to basic services · Expand water and sanitation services

name: Electrification and household time use
chain: Works when affordability and reliability · How household electricity → light and appliances free time, especially women's · Result employment and study time; small average income gains

name: Water, sanitation and disease burden
cite: Cutler and Miller 2005; Duflo, Greenstone, Guiteras and Clasen 2015
chain: Works when use and maintenance · How safe water and sanitation → lower faecal contamination cuts disease · Result child mortality and diarrhoea

name: Household air pollution from cooking fuels
chain: Works when sustained use (Hanna et al. 2016) · How cooking fuel and stove → clean fuels cut indoor smoke · Result respiratory disease

name: Housing quality and health
cite: Cattaneo et al. 2009; Galiani et al. 2017
chain: Works when Health effects depend on the specific housing exposure altered (for example dirt floors and enteric pathogens), baseline exposure and implementation; improvements in housing satisfaction do not imply universal or consistent health, income or labour effects (source-verified 20 Oct 2026) · How floors, roofs and structure → better housing cuts parasites and exposure · Result child health and wellbeing
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Knowledge
def: Schooling, skills for work, and digital access and use.

name: Knowledge: schooling
def: Knowledge and skills built through early childhood, school and university.
ex: Examples from plans Improve education quality · Reform education governance and management · Expand inclusive education

name: School access and attainment
chain: Works when teacher supply · How school supply and proximity → more schools and places raise attainment · Result years of schooling and earnings

name: Learning quality and cognitive skills
cite: Hanushek and Woessmann 2008; Glewwe and Muralidharan 2016
chain: Works when measurement of learning · How learning outcomes → cognitive skills, not years, drive growth · Result growth and earnings

name: Teacher supply, effort and accountability
cite: Muralidharan and Sundararaman 2011; Duflo, Hanna and Ryan 2012
chain: Works when credible monitoring · How teacher recruitment, pay and incentives → effort and presence respond to incentives and monitoring · Result learning

name: Early-childhood skill formation
chain: Works when quality of provision · How investment in early childhood → skills beget skills; dynamic complementarity · Result later learning and earnings

name: Demand-side cost barriers to schooling
chain: Works when school supply · How fees and opportunity costs → lower costs raise enrolment of poorer students · Result enrolment and completion

name: School-based health and attendance
chain: Works when coverage · How health and nutrition services at school → healthier children attend and learn more · Result attendance and learning
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Skills for work
def: Job-relevant skills formed after or alongside schooling, and the signals that make them pay.
ex: Examples from plans Build workforce skills · Strengthen technical and vocational education · Build digital skills and literacy

name: Race between education and technology
chain: Works when technology direction · How supply of skills → skill supply keeps pace or not with skill-biased demand · Result wage premium and inequality

name: Returns to vocational training
chain: Works when employer links; quality · How classroom and practical training → skills raise earnings and formal employment · Result employment and earnings

name: Work-based learning and the school-to-work transition
chain: Works when employer participation · How apprenticeships and work placements → learning on the job eases the transition to employment · Result youth employment

name: Skill signals and mismatch
chain: Works when recognition by employers · How qualifications and labour-market information → credible signals reduce mismatch · Result match quality and returns

name: Digital skill complementarity
chain: Works when access to technology · How digital skills → complements digital technology, raising productivity of skilled workers · Result wages and adoption
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Digital access and use
def: Household and individual access to, and effective use of, digital connectivity and devices.
ex: Examples from plans Expand digital inclusion

name: Household digital access and effective use
cite: Hjort and Poulsen 2019 (source still to check)
chain: Works when affordability and digital skills · How connectivity, devices and affordability → access lowers information and transaction costs · Result employment, services use and inclusion
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Future Generations
rule: Why these groups Inclusive wealth (UNEP IWR 2018; World Bank CWON 2021; OECD How's Life?); IPCC; ILO 2015 just transition guidelines. Future well-being depends on the climate system and on natural, produced and human capital stocks.

name: Climate
def: Cutting emissions, protecting people and assets from climate hazards, and a fair transition.
basis: IPCC mitigation and adaptation; ILO 2015 just transition

name: Climate stabilisation and just transition
def: Reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, and the adjustment of workers and places to decarbonisation.
ex: Examples from plans Expand renewable energy · Mobilise climate and environmental finance · Strengthen climate governance

name: Emissions pricing and the climate externality
chain: Works when coverage and level; clubs against free-riding · How a price on emissions → pricing internalises the global externality · Result emissions

name: Directed technical change to clean technology
chain: Works when path dependence · How subsidies and research for clean technology → redirects innovation from dirty to clean · Result clean technology share

name: Learning curves in clean technology
chain: Works when global deployment · How deployment of solar, wind, batteries → cumulative deployment drives cost declines · Result cheaper clean energy

name: Energy-efficiency gap
chain: Works when rebound effects · How efficiency standards and information → information and principal-agent failures leave efficiency unadopted · Result energy use

name: Carbon lock-in of long-lived capital
chain: Works when turnover rate of capital · How long-lived high-carbon infrastructure → sunk capital and institutions lock in emissions · Result persistent emissions or stranded assets

name: Local labour-market adjustment to decarbonisation
chain: Works when mobility, retraining, place-based support · How closure of fossil-dependent activity → concentrated job and revenue losses in specific places · Result local employment, earnings and fiscal base
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Climate risk to assets and people
def: Losses from climate hazards, and the location, protection and practice changes that reduce them.
ex: Examples from plans Build climate resilience and adaptation · Reduce disaster risk · Reduce flood risk

name: Exposure reduction through location and land use
chain: Works when income and institutions (Kahn 2005) · How where people and assets locate → less exposure lowers losses for a given hazard · Result disaster losses

name: Asset protection through hardened infrastructure
chain: Works when maintenance · How resilient design and protective works → hardened assets fail less · Result disruption losses

name: Ecosystem buffers against hazards
chain: Works when ecosystem extent · How mangroves, wetlands and forests → ecosystems absorb surge and floods · Result deaths and damage

name: Adaptive change in production practices
chain: Works when information and finance · How practices adjusted to climate → producers change crops, timing and inputs · Result losses avoided

name: Asset vulnerability and well-being losses of the poor
chain: Works when coping capacity · How assets held by poor households → the poor lose a larger share of assets and recover more slowly · Result well-being losses beyond asset losses
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Natural capital
def: Ecosystems, water and environmental quality as assets held for future generations.

name: Living natural capital
def: Ecosystems, wild stocks and land as assets under common-pool and incentive problems.
ex: Examples from plans Conserve biodiversity and wildlife · Manage fisheries sustainably · Manage natural resources sustainably

name: Open-access depletion and common-pool governance
chain: Works when clear boundaries and monitoring · How rules over common resources → without rules users over-extract; local institutions can manage · Result stock levels

name: Rights-based harvest management
chain: Works when monitoring and enforcement · How catch shares and harvest limits → secure shares end the race to fish · Result stock recovery

name: Protected-area habitat protection
cite: Andam et al. 2008; Naidoo et al. 2019
chain: Works when enforcement; leakage · How protected status → protection reduces conversion of habitat · Result habitat and species

name: Conservation incentives through nature-based income
cite: Jayachandran et al. 2017; Naidoo et al. 2019
chain: Works when additionality · How payments or incomes tied to conservation → aligns local incentives with conservation · Result forest cover and local income

name: Political economy of deforestation
chain: Works when jurisdiction design · How local political incentives → decentralised rent-seeking raises illegal logging · Result deforestation

name: Restoration returns on degraded land
chain: Works when land tenure · How restoration investment → restored land yields ecosystem and production returns · Result productivity and services

name: Invasive species and biosecurity
chain: Works when border controls · How entry and spread of invasive species → invasives displace natives and damage production · Result biodiversity and output losses
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Water resources
def: Allocation of scarce, variable and shared water.
ex: Examples from plans Manage water resources · Expand water storage and transfer · Improve water efficiency

name: Scarcity pricing and allocation
chain: Works when metering and enforcement · How prices and allocation rules for water → prices and tradable rights move water to higher-value uses · Result efficient use under scarcity

name: Groundwater commons depletion
chain: Works when electricity pricing for pumps · How pumping from shared aquifers → unpriced pumping depletes the aquifer · Result falling water tables

name: Storage and hydrological variability
chain: Works when variability of rainfall · How storage relative to variability → storage smooths supply across seasons and years · Result reliable supply and growth

name: Transboundary basin cooperation
chain: Works when institutional capacity · How shared river basins → treaties and institutions turn rivalry into cooperation · Result joint management, lower conflict
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Environmental quality
def: Local pollution and waste as drawdown of environmental sinks, with health and human-capital costs.
ex: Examples from plans Improve waste management · Control pollution · Promote cleaner production and sustainable consumption

name: Regulation and pricing of local pollution
chain: Works when enforcement capacity · How standards, levies and taxes on local pollutants → binding regulation reduces emissions where enforced · Result pollution

name: Pollution exposure and human capital
cite: Chay and Greenstone 2003; Graff Zivin and Neidell 2012; Ebenstein et al. 2017
chain: Works when exposure of children · How exposure to air and water pollution → pollution harms health, cognition and productivity · Result mortality, learning, productivity

name: Scale, composition and technique effects
cite: Grossman and Krueger 1995; Copeland and Taylor 2004; Stern 2004
chain: Works when regulation must bind (Stern 2004) · How growth and cleaner techniques → pollution rises with scale and falls with composition and technique · Result pollution per unit of output

name: Waste collection, disposal and circular material flows
chain: Works when collection coverage · How collection, recycling and disposal → uncollected and unmanaged waste pollutes; recovery returns materials · Result pollution and recovered materials

name: Toxic exposure and child development
chain: Works when The measured effect depends on the pollutant and biomarker, exposure level and age at measurement, the outcome assessed, and whether an intervention actually reduces exposure. For lead, Aizer et al. study preschool blood lead and later third-grade achievement; prenatal timing and other pollutants need separate citations (source-verified 20 Oct 2026) · How lead and other neurotoxic substances → early-life exposure impairs cognitive development (evidence so far is for lead) · Result later learning and health

name: Information and social norms in environmental behaviour
chain: Works when persistence · How information, education and social comparison → norms and feedback change energy and water use · Result resource use and pollution
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Economic and human wealth
def: Resource rents, the public balance sheet and demographic change across generations.
basis: Inclusive wealth: produced, fiscal and human capital

name: Subsoil wealth and resource rents
def: Extraction of exhaustible resources and whether the rents are reinvested.
ex: Examples from plans Strengthen mining and resource governance · Develop the mining sector · Expand fossil fuel exploration and production

name: Rent reinvestment
chain: Works when investment quality · How resource rents → reinvesting rents in other capital keeps wealth from falling · Result wealth and consumption across generations

name: Dutch disease
cite: Corden and Neary 1982; Sachs and Warner 1995
chain: Works when absorption and sterilisation · How resource boom → real appreciation crowds out other tradables · Result a narrower economy

name: Rent-seeking and institutional quality
chain: Works when institutional quality · How resource rents → rents are captured unless institutions are producer-friendly · Result growth outcomes

name: Volatility of resource revenues and procyclical spending
chain: Works when fiscal rules · How volatile commodity revenues → procyclical spending amplifies booms and busts · Result growth and fiscal stability
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Public balance sheet
def: Whether debt and fiscal policy shift burdens onto future taxpayers.
ex: Examples from plans Strengthen fiscal sustainability · Strengthen fiscal governance

name: Debt dynamics and fiscal reaction
chain: Works when fiscal fatigue at high debt · How primary balance responses to debt → sustainability requires surpluses to rise with debt · Result debt path

name: Debt overhang and investment
chain: Works when level and composition of debt · How high public debt → expected taxes to service debt depress investment · Result lower investment and growth

name: Fiscal rules and procyclicality
cite: Kaminsky, Reinhart and Vegh 2004; Frankel, Vegh and Vuletin 2013
chain: Works when credibility and escape clauses · How fiscal rules and institutions → rules restrain procyclical spending · Result fiscal stability

name: Contingent liabilities and hidden debt
chain: Works when disclosure · How guarantees, SOE and PPP liabilities → liabilities crystallise in shocks · Result debt jumps

name: Intergenerational fiscal burden
chain: Works when ageing · How fiscal policy over the lifecycle → current policy shifts net taxes between generations · Result burden on future generations
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Human and demographic capital
def: Fertility, ageing and lifecycle behaviour that change labour input, saving and care across generations.
ex: Examples from plans Manage population and demographic change · Expand reproductive health services · Expand elderly care

name: Fertility control and family size
chain: Works when demand for smaller families · How access to family planning → control over timing and number of births · Result lower fertility, more schooling and work for women

name: Quantity-quality trade-off
chain: Works when returns to education · How returns to child human capital → parents trade number of children for investment per child · Result human capital per child

name: Lifecycle saving and the second dividend
cite: Mason and Lee 2006; Lee and Mason 2010
chain: Works when financial institutions · How a larger share of prime-age savers → lifecycle saving raises capital per worker · Result higher income per capita

name: Older-worker participation
chain: Works when health · How retirement rules and incentives → incentives to keep working raise labour input · Result participation at older ages

name: Long-term care demand and family caregiving
chain: Works when formal care supply · How ageing → care needs rise; families, mostly women, supply it unpaid · Result care gaps and lost female labour supply

name: General People
note: Routine government functions with no development mechanism. No groups or families.

name: Export-led
rule: Why these groups Commission on Growth and Development 2008, The Growth Report; WDR 2020 on global value chains. Economies grow through external markets by tapping global demand, importing know-how, and linking to foreign capital and value chains.

name: Reaching foreign markets
def: Trade costs, market access and services exports such as tourism.

name: Cost of reaching foreign markets
def: Fixed, variable and time costs of trading and the terms of access to foreign markets.
ex: Examples from plans Facilitate trade · Expand and modernise ports and shipping · Improve logistics and freight

name: Market-entry cost reduction
cite: Melitz 2003; Das, Roberts and Tybout 2007; Maertens and Swinnen 2009
chain: Works when heterogeneous firms near the threshold · How lower fixed costs of entering export markets (standards, certification, information) → more firms clear the fixed-cost threshold to export · Result higher export participation (extensive margin)

name: Variable trade-cost reduction
cite: Limao and Venables 2001; Clark, Dollar and Micco 2004; Anderson and van Wincoop 2004
chain: Works when competition in transport services; port efficiency · How lower per-unit freight, port and handling costs → delivered prices fall, so traded volumes and reach expand · Result higher trade volumes (intensive margin)

name: Time-sensitivity of trade
cite: Djankov, Freund and Pham 2010; Hummels and Schaur 2013
chain: Works when reliability matters as much as speed · How shorter, more predictable border and transit times → time-sensitive goods and network inputs become viable · Result participation in production networks and time-sensitive trade

name: Air-link knowledge and investment flows
chain: Works when routes to economic hubs · How direct air connections → face-to-face contact lowers the cost of business travel, knowledge flows and investment · Result higher FDI, business links and growth in connected places

name: Trade creation through agreements and blocs
chain: Works when low external tariffs limit diversion; deep provisions matter · How preferential or regional reductions in barriers → lower barriers among members create trade (net of diversion) · Result higher trade and welfare among members

name: Preference-margin effects on market access
chain: Works when rules of origin; supply response · How unilateral tariff preferences and their erosion → preferences raise the price received; losing them lowers it · Result exports in preference-sensitive goods

name: Import-competition productivity effects
cite: Pavcnik 2002; Amiti and Konings 2007; Topalova and Khandelwal 2011
chain: Works when complementary reforms allow exit and reallocation · How lower own tariffs on outputs and inputs → competition and cheaper inputs raise productivity and variety · Result higher productivity of domestic firms
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Tourism export destinations
def: Foreign visitor spending as a services export: spillovers, carrying capacity and shock exposure.
ex: Examples from plans Develop tourism · Diversify tourism markets and products · Promote sustainable tourism

name: Tourism-led local spillovers
chain: Works when linkages to local suppliers · How visitor spending in a place → demand for local services and agglomeration spill over into other sectors · Result local employment and output beyond tourism

name: Destination life cycle and carrying capacity
chain: Works when fragile ecosystems and heritage · How growth in visitor numbers → congestion and degradation erode the destination's appeal · Result stagnation or decline without management

name: Tourism demand volatility and shock exposure
chain: Works when concentration of source markets · How health, security or climate shocks → travel demand collapses faster than other exports · Result large swings in receipts and jobs
fh: L4 General: the plan names this area but not how the policy works

name: Upgrading and innovation
def: Export upgrading, diversification and the innovation system.
basis: Growth Report: importing ideas, technology and know-how

name: Self-discovery and export upgrading
def: Learning, related diversification and reallocation toward new and upgraded traded products.
ex: Examples from plans Expand and diversify exports · Develop manufacturing industries · Develop creative and cultural industries

name: Learning by exporting
cite: De Loecker 2007; Atkin, Khandelwal and Osman 2017
chain: Works when firms with capacity to absorb feedback; buyers who demand quality · How exposure to foreign buyers and markets → buyer demands and feedback transfer know-how to the exporting firm · Result higher firm productivity and product quality
